# Seng Heng Shipping

> Trusted marine and offshore service partner based in Miri, Sarawak, Malaysia, operating since 1998. Services cover marine and offshore operations, shipping and freight forwarding, equipment rental and supply, engineering and shipyard services, and a managed fleet of 10 vessels. Service area: Sarawak, Sabah, East and West Malaysia, Labuan, and Brunei.

## Services

- [Marine & Offshore Operations](https://www.senghengshipping.com/services/marine-offshore-operations): Personnel transfer, document delivery, vessel supply, ship chandling, and offshore support in Sarawak and surrounding waters.
- [Logistics & Transport Solutions](https://www.senghengshipping.com/services/logistics-transport-solutions): Customs clearance, air and sea freight forwarding, inland transport, 30,000 sq ft warehousing, packing and handling, and barge/tug services.
- [Engineering & Shipyard Services](https://www.senghengshipping.com/services/engineering-shipyard-services): Welding, steel and aluminium fabrication, ship repairs, and marine engineering support.
- [Marine Equipment & General Supplies](https://www.senghengshipping.com/services/marine-equipment-general-supplies): Generator rental (10–35 KVA), hydraulic A-frame, tugger winch, DNV-certified offshore containers, refrigerated containers, and general marine supplies.
- [Car Rental Service](https://www.senghengshipping.com/services/car-rental-service): Vehicle rental for offshore personnel and corporate clients in Miri.

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.senghengshipping.com/about-us): Company background, history, and team since 1998.
- [Company Profile](https://www.senghengshipping.com/about-us/company-profile): Full company profile including registration, capabilities, and certifications.
- [Vision & Mission](https://www.senghengshipping.com/about-us/vision-mission): Corporate vision, mission, and core values.
- [HSE](https://www.senghengshipping.com/about-us/hse): Health, Safety, and Environment policy and commitment.
- [Our Fleet](https://www.senghengshipping.com/our-fleet): 10 vessels — offshore support vessel MV. Mega Maria (34 m LOA), passenger and pilot boats (11.8–19.1 m), and landing craft Seng Heng Progress (19.5 m). Ship particulars available for each vessel.
- [Our Clients](https://www.senghengshipping.com/our-clients): Key clients include Petronas, Dialog, Petros, Dayang DESB, Enviros, SK Offshore, HGIS, and Cheimsain.
- [Contact Us](https://www.senghengshipping.com/contact): Office in Miri, Sarawak. Enquiries for marine, offshore, and logistics services in East Malaysia, Labuan, and Brunei.
